note: Waxys Phantoms Hall of Fame: legends inducted by the captain. Separate from the Waxy d'Or and season awards. Each entry: name (EA name), title (short honour line), citation (why), inducted (YYYY-MM-DD).

legends.name: Poke_1101
legends.title: Club legend · the engine room
legends.citation: Tito runs the middle of the park. 84% passing, 53 tackles and 8 assists, and the Phantoms win two games in three when Tito plays.

legends.name: Portugal__23
legends.title: Club legend · the finisher
legends.citation: D. Jota up top: 6 goals and 2 man-of-the-match awards in 13 games, and a 69% win rate, the best of the three legends.

legends.name: DYL_597
legends.title: Club legend · a goal or an assist every game
legends.citation: 13 goal involvements in 9 games (8 goals, 5 assists) and a 7.8 average match rating. Didn’t take long to leave a mark.
